newsitem.title: UK: AB Ports launches UK dredging division.
newsitem.headline: AB Ports launches UK dredging division.

text.p: The UK's largest ports group Associated British Ports Holdings Plc said it has consolidated its dredging activities into a single new division, UK Dredging.
UK Dredging will continue to fulfill AB Ports' dredging requirements but also market surplus capacity for third party work, the group said.
AB Ports added in a statement: "It was decided that the company's dredging activities should be consolidated to provide a more commercially orientated and efficient operation."

The new division's fleet of three trailing suction hopper dredges will be "significantly updated in May with the arrival of the 14 million pounds suction dredger, UKD Bluefin, being built by Ferguson Shipbuilders Limited," AB Ports added.
UK Dredging will also be responsible for port hydrographic surveys in South Wales, it said.
